questions.question: GCP resurs ierarxiyasi va asosiy servislar: Organization, Folder, Project. AWS bilan solishtirish?
questions.explanation: Organization → Folder → Project → Resource. Project — billing, API, IAM va quota chegarasi (AWS account'ga yaqin). IAM policy yuqoridan pastga meros qoladi.

questions.question: Cloud Run nima va qachon Kubernetes o'rniga ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Cloud Run — container'ni serverless ishga tushiradi: HTTP so'rovga qarab 0 dan N gacha avtomatik scale, faqat ishlatilgan vaqt uchun to'lov, klaster boshqaruvi yo'q. Stateless HTTP servis, webhook, cron job uchun ideal.

questions.question: GCP'da service account va Workload Identity Federation: kalitsiz autentifikatsiya qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Service account — ilova identiteti. JSON key yuklab olish — eng ko'p uchraydigan oqish manbai. GKE'da Workload Identity (K8s SA ↔ GCP SA), tashqi CI'da Workload Identity Federation (GitHub OIDC token → GCP qisqa token) — kalit yo'q.

questions.question: GKE Autopilot va Standard farqi? Qachon qaysi biri?
questions.explanation: Standard — node'larni o'zingiz boshqarasiz (node pool, machine type, DaemonSet erkin), node uchun to'laysiz. Autopilot — Google node'larni boshqaradi, pod requests uchun to'laysiz, xavfsizlik cheklovlari (privileged yo'q, hostPath cheklangan).

questions.question: GCP IAM: basic, predefined va custom role'lar; nega `roles/editor` xavfli?
questions.explanation: Basic role'lar (Owner, Editor, Viewer) — juda keng, minglab permission. Predefined — servisga xos (`roles/storage.objectViewer`). Custom — aniq permission ro'yxati. Editor deyarli hamma resursni o'zgartira oladi — least privilege'ga zid, default compute SA'ga berilgani xavf.
